audit.whatIsWrong: Row 6 (2+ items) read Akali in both layers, contradicting the packet chart, the 51.37% win rate and whys[6], which already says Vladimir out-sustains her.
audit.why: Crimson Pact health plus Hemoplague beats a burst pattern once Vladimir has two items; the page rendered two answers.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side and win[6] flipped to Vladimir as a matched pair, rating 5/10 to 6/10, phases[6].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere; spikes described 'her level-2 spike' with no window attached.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16, Perfect Execution 120/90/60, Sanguine Pool 28 at rank 1. The trade window is literally the shroud cooldown.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into spikes[0], spikes[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text claimed 'her Q heals' and 'Q sustain'. Five Point Strike does no healing in Riot's description. Tides of Blood being body-blocked by enemy units was never stated. Assassin's Mark's auto reset tell was absent.
audit.why: Vladimir's E explicitly 'can be blocked by enemy units' — charging it from behind your own wave is the strongest early counterplay in the lane, exactly as the mirror audit found. Akali's burst opens with the empowered step-out auto, so the wind-up is the cue, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Fake Q healing removed; minion-block written into early and mid; Assassin's Mark tell written into report[5].

audit.why: Both packet suspectNames are false positives: Twilight Shroud and Perfect Execution are Akali's real W and R.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Akali carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Crimson Pact health and Hemoplague outlast her rotation. Close it before the map decides instead of you.

edits.before: Level 3 keeps her ahead as shroud resets and Q sustain win short trades.
edits.after: Level 3 keeps her ahead: Twilight Shroud drops your Q's target lock mid-trade.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — trade Transfusion for Five Point Strike and neither commits. Zone her off last-hits before she hits her level-2 shroud spike.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — trade Transfusion for Five Point Strike and neither commits. Charge Tides from behind your wave; enemy units block it entirely.

edits.before: From 2 through 6 Akali holds the edge: shroud breaks your Q lock, her Q heals, and Perfect Execution executes you. Play patient, save Pool for her second dash, and don't shove into ganks.
edits.after: From 2 through 6 Akali holds the edge: shroud breaks your Q lock and Perfect Execution executes you. Charge Tides behind your minions — they body-block it — and save Pool for her second R cast.

edits.before: Akali's level-2 spike with Twilight Shroud plus Five Point Strike lets her all-in and vanish from your Transfusion; her Q sustain and shroud reset make short trades dangerous once she has both abilities.
edits.after: Akali's level-2 spike with Twilight Shroud plus Five Point Strike lets her all-in and vanish from your Transfusion; the shroud is a 20s cooldown, so the gap after she burns it is your entire trade window.

edits.before: Perfect Execution gives her two dashes and a big execute; save Sanguine Pool for the second-cast damage, not the first dash, or she'll finish you after Pool ends.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is two dashes with the execute on the recast; hold Sanguine Pool's 2s untargetability for that second cast, not the first dash, or she finishes you as it ends.

edits.before: Track Akali's Twilight Shroud: Untargetable inside. Poke when down. When it is down — Q-E + R her.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable; her Assassin's Mark step-out auto is the burst tell, not the cast.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside. Poke when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud: 20s, unselectable inside — poke the gap, don't chase in. - Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1, never spend it on chip. - Perfect Execution: 120s at 6, and the recast is the execute. - Hemoplague: 120s, kill windows only.
